notes.title: 5 YEARS AGO A CHICKEN WAS BORN!
notes.content:
[b]HEY GUYS!!! Boy, it's been a long time since I have posted any updates or news about this game. First off though, Happy Anniversary to WHY CHICKEN? WHY? !!! This game was released on Steam 5 years ago to this day. Long story short, currently I am not able to update the game itself any further because I need to try and retrieve the file off my old PC that won't boot...lol. So the chicken will have to remain as it is for now. I hope to update it someday though. I did this project to mostly prove to myself I could finish and release a game, but wanted to make something fun & old school. Are there bugs? Probably...Should I have used consistent art & non-paid assets? Yep. ...Should my text fonts all been the same in the UI. For sure. Did I do any marketing? Not much....These are all failures I'm willing to take to learn & live my dream of game creation. Stay tuned for announcements on my upcoming project (MALOIK: THE METAL HAND). A platformer/metroidvania with a heavy metal theme. \m/[/b]

notes.title: WHY CHICKEN? WHY? has released on Steam for Windows PC!!!
notes.content:
Hello,

After about 5 years or so of off and on development I'm releasing my first official game on Steam today (Why Chicken? Why?). This game is an homage to old school games I grew up playing in the 80's-90's. Only fellow solo developers might know the struggle that goes into creating a game yourself (no matter how big or small). Some games are even born out of mild to severe tragedy. I encourage you to give me a fair chance and play the game through a bit before you compare. All art and games are influenced by other games and this is my take or my vision in it's own way. Some games also write themselves a bit and I might have had less to do with this as I thought. I hope you think it's a fair price as the struggle I went through feels like more, though it always does. Please let me know of issues but keep it nice and clean. I am willing to work to make my game the best experience it can be with updates, ext. Give Feathers a chance. He might just grow on you. #Feathers4Life

Thank you,
J.R.
Number77Studios
